BREAKING: Town library opens after three years of construction • Weather: sunny spells

Library opens its doors after three years

By Staff Reporter · 2 hours ago

The new community library opened on Saturday, with shelves for more than 40,000 books, a quiet reading room, and free computers for anyone who needs them. Hundreds of residents queued before the doors opened at nine.

Staff said the building was designed with help from local residents, who asked for comfortable seating, good lighting, step-free access, and a children's corner with its own entrance. See the opening hours.

The project ran two years late after problems with the foundations, and cost the council about 20 percent more than planned. Councillors said the delay was frustrating, but that the finished building would serve the town for decades.

What's inside

  • A quiet reading room on the first floor
  • Twenty public computers with free printing
  • Bookable rooms for community groups

Membership is free for anyone who lives, works, or studies in the town. You can join online, or bring proof of address to the front desk, and borrow up to fifteen items at a time.
